hunks.baseline: “Ugh, every bone in my body hurts.”
hunks.sol: “Ugh, every bone in my body aches.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin groaned. His exposed upper body was stained dark reddish-black all over.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin groaned. His bare upper body was covered in dark reddish-black bruises.

hunks.baseline: At the sight, the cantankerous-looking old man—the Medicine King Hall Master—clicked his tongue.
hunks.sol: At the sight, the crotchety-looking old man—the Medicine King Hall Master—clicked his tongue.

hunks.baseline: When he untied the bundle he had brought with him, stake-like acupuncture needles were revealed. Hyuk Mujin asked in a trembling voice:
hunks.sol: He untied the bundle he had brought with him, revealing acupuncture needles as thick as stakes. Hyuk Mujin asked in a terrified voice, “You’re going to stick those in me?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re going to stick those in me?”
“They look like they’ll hurt like hell… Please go easy, if possible.”
hunks.sol: “They look like they’ll hurt like hell… Please go easy on me.”

hunks.baseline: “Sure, why not.”
hunks.sol: “Sure.”

hunks.baseline: The Medicine King Hall Master answered cheerfully and took out two large needles.
hunks.sol: The Medicine King Hall Master answered readily and took out two large needles.

hunks.baseline: “Now you’re finally ready to be treated.”
hunks.sol: “Now you’re ready for treatment.”

hunks.baseline: After silencing Hyuk Mujin with a single sentence, the Medicine King Hall Master got to work. In the blink of an eye, dozens of large and small needles pierced Hyuk Mujin’s skin.
hunks.sol: Having silenced Hyuk Mujin with a single sentence, the Medicine King Hall Master got to work. In the blink of an eye, dozens of needles, large and small, pierced Hyuk Mujin’s skin.

hunks.baseline: “A young punk like you, making such a fuss. From the sound of that voice, you’ll be hale for another fifty years.”
hunks.sol: “A young punk like you, making such a fuss. From the sound of those lungs, you’ll be hale and hearty for another fifty years.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving Hyuk Mujin, who had turned into a porcupine, behind, the Medicine King Hall Master turned his head toward me.
hunks.sol: Leaving the now porcupine-like Hyuk Mujin behind, the Medicine King Hall Master turned to me.

hunks.baseline: “Take it off.”
hunks.sol: “Strip.”

hunks.baseline: “What, what?”
hunks.sol: “W-What?”

hunks.baseline: When it came to age, to hell with being the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi or anything else. I shot a sidelong glance at the blue-glinting needles and took off my top.
hunks.sol: When age entered the equation, being the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi could go straight to hell. I eyed the blue-glinting needles and took off my shirt.

hunks.baseline: “What are you made of?”
hunks.sol: “What the hell are you?”

hunks.baseline: His voice was filled with astonishment. It was understandable. Until yesterday, my body had been covered in bruises, but now it was clean.
hunks.sol: His voice was full of astonishment, and understandably so. Until yesterday, my body had been covered in bruises. Now, my skin was completely clear.

hunks.baseline: *I didn’t expect this much, either.*
hunks.sol: *I didn’t expect this much either.*

hunks.baseline: After sleeping through the night, most of the bruises had disappeared, and even the bones that had been aching felt fine.
hunks.sol: After a single night’s sleep, most of the bruises had disappeared, and even my aching bones felt perfectly fine.

hunks.baseline: It seemed that simply sleeping now let me recover quickly from most ordinary bruises. Even the Medicine King Hall Master, who had spent years as a physician, found me fascinating and examined me for quite some time.
hunks.sol: Apparently, simply sleeping was now enough for me to recover quickly from most ordinary bruises. Even the Medicine King Hall Master, a physician seasoned by years of experience, found me so remarkable that he examined me for quite some time.

hunks.baseline: “Did you take an elixir during the night?”
hunks.sol: “Did you take an elixir last night?”

hunks.baseline: “No. I just circulated my qi all day and slept deeply.”
hunks.sol: “No. I just circulated my qi all day and got a good night’s sleep.”

hunks.baseline: “Is it the effect of the hundred-year snow ginseng? No, that’s too much…”
hunks.sol: “Could it be the hundred-year snow ginseng? No, this is too much…”

hunks.baseline: The Medicine King Hall Master glared at me suspiciously, as if wondering whether I had raided the medicine storeroom again, then shook his head.
hunks.sol: The Medicine King Hall Master glared at me suspiciously, as though wondering whether I had raided the medicine storeroom again, then shook his head.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin, who had been groaning, brightened.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin, who had been groaning, immediately brightened.

hunks.baseline: “I swear, if you run off again without permission, I’ll jab your perineum with a large needle.”
hunks.sol: “I swear, if you run off again without permission, I’ll ram one of these needles into your perineum.”

hunks.baseline: The gaunt old man muttered in a sinister voice as he raised a large needle and stabbed it through the air. He looked like something straight out of a horror movie.
hunks.sol: The gaunt old man muttered in a sinister voice, jabbing a large needle through the air. He looked like something straight out of a horror movie.

hunks.baseline: *That’s going to be one bloody opening ceremony.*
hunks.sol: *That’ll be one bloody opening ceremony.*

hunks.baseline: “Third Young Master, get out. Unless you want to be needled.”
hunks.sol: “Third Young Master, get out. Unless you want the needles too.”

hunks.baseline: *Thanks…*
hunks.sol: *Thank you…*

hunks.baseline: That was the moment I jumped to my feet to escape those eyes gleaming with madness.
hunks.sol: I sprang to my feet, eager to escape those eyes gleaming with madness.

hunks.baseline: A sudden flash of insight crossed my mind.
hunks.sol: Then a sudden realization struck me.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: The pavilion had collapsed, so I had nowhere to return to. I had become homeless overnight, and was hesitating when—
hunks.sol: The pavilion had collapsed, leaving me with nowhere to return to. I had become homeless overnight, and as I stood there hesitating—

hunks.baseline: A familiar voice came from outside the door. I opened it, half expecting the impossible, and saw the face I had anticipated.
hunks.sol: A familiar voice came from beyond the door. Wondering if it could really be him, I opened it and found exactly the face I had expected.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung jumped a beat late.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung jumped a beat too late.

hunks.baseline: “No, what are you doing here? I came because I had something urgent to discuss with the Medicine King Hall Master during my duties. What an incredible coincidence!”
hunks.sol: “What are you doing here? I happened to stop by in the middle of my duties because I had urgent business with the Medicine King Hall Master. What an incredible coincidence!”

hunks.baseline: After hearing my situation, Jin Wikyung led the way with a solemn expression.
hunks.sol: After hearing about my situation, Jin Wikyung led the way with a solemn expression.

hunks.baseline: “I know of a place you can use as a residence for a while. Follow me.”
hunks.sol: “I know somewhere you can stay for a while. Follow me.”

hunks.baseline: His behavior was clearly influenced by the eyes around us. The image he had built over the years was that of a cold, capable Lesser Family Head who strictly separated public and private affairs.
hunks.sol: He was clearly conscious of the people watching us. After all, the image he had built over the years was that of a coolheaded, capable Lesser Family Head who kept public and private matters strictly separate.

hunks.baseline: “The Lesser Family Head!”
hunks.sol: “It’s the Lesser Family Head.”

hunks.baseline: “Maybe he can’t stand being apart from him for even an instant. He absolutely dotes on the Third Young Master.”
hunks.sol: “Maybe he can’t bear to be apart from him for even a moment. You know how he dotes on the Third Young Master.”

hunks.baseline: Anyone who paid attention already knew: Jin Wikyung was a complete fool for his little brother.
hunks.sol: Everyone who paid any attention already knew the truth: Jin Wikyung was a complete sucker for his little brother.

hunks.baseline: *Of course they did. Anyone who didn’t know would be the abnormal one.*
hunks.sol: *Of course they know. Anyone who doesn’t would be the strange one.*

hunks.baseline: He was still like this in his mid-thirties. I could only imagine what he had been like when he was younger. After the battle ended, he had even been so happy that he carried me around on his shoulders.
hunks.sol: He was still like this in his mid-thirties. I could only imagine how bad he had been when he was younger. Right after the battle, he had even been so overcome with joy that he carried me around on his shoulders.

hunks.baseline: After making such a spectacle in front of hundreds of people, there was no way anyone could have missed it.
hunks.sol: After making that kind of spectacle in front of hundreds of people, there was no way anyone could have missed it.

hunks.baseline: —How was that? Hyung can act, too, huh?
hunks.sol: —How was that? Hyung can act too, huh?

hunks.baseline: I nodded, thinking that if there were an Academy Award for terrible acting, he might even contend for Best Actor.
hunks.sol: I nodded. If there were an Academy Award for terrible acting, he might have had a shot at Best Actor.

hunks.baseline: —Are you all right? Mukyung didn’t do it out of malice, so I hope you’ll understand him.
hunks.sol: —Are you feeling all right? Mukyung didn’t do it out of malice, so I hope you’ll understand.

hunks.baseline: His fists had been overflowing with malice. It was only thanks to my rapid recovery that I had not spent several days staring at the Medicine King Hall ceiling.
hunks.sol: There had been plenty of malice in those fists. It was only thanks to my rapid recovery that I hadn’t spent the next several days staring at the Medicine King Hall ceiling.

hunks.baseline: That kid had a nasty temper, and the martial arts to back it up. There was no dealing with him.
hunks.sol: He was young, ill-tempered, and had the martial arts to back it up. There was no dealing with him.

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung had shot straight up to the number-one spot on my internal watch list the moment he appeared.
hunks.sol: The moment Jin Mukyung appeared, he had shot straight to the top of my internal watch list.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung, unaware of my inner thoughts, laughed heartily and continued walking.
hunks.sol: Oblivious to my thoughts, Jin Wikyung laughed heartily and continued walking.

hunks.baseline: We passed through the bustling center of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and kept going. The farther we went, the fewer people we saw.
hunks.sol: We passed through the bustling heart of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and kept going. The farther we went, the fewer people we saw.

hunks.baseline: The area occupied by the Jin Family of Taiyuan was enormous, a reminder of its former glory. Even from a distance, it looked as though several soccer fields had been joined together, so it was only natural that I couldn’t see everything. There were still unfamiliar places everywhere my feet took me.
hunks.sol: The sheer size of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s estate spoke to its former glory. Even from a distance, it looked as large as several soccer fields combined, so it was only natural that I had never explored all of it. Everywhere I went, I still found places I had never seen before.

hunks.baseline: Now the people had disappeared completely, leaving the road empty. The occasional pavilion and the buildings whose purposes I couldn’t identify were old and gloomy.
hunks.sol: By now, the people had disappeared completely, leaving the road deserted. The occasional pavilion and other buildings whose purposes I couldn’t identify were old and gloomy.

hunks.baseline: It had the kind of atmosphere where rats could hold a sports festival during the day and ghosts could play go-stop at night.[^1]
hunks.sol: It had the kind of atmosphere where rats held sports festivals during the day and ghosts played go-stop at night.[^1]

hunks.baseline: “Given how things have been for our family, even maintaining this much has been more than we could manage. We’ll need to carry out extensive renovations now, of course.”
hunks.sol: “Given the state our family has been in, maintaining even this much was more than we could manage. Now we’ll have to undertake extensive renovations, of course.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t really care.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t really mind.”

hunks.baseline: I had lasted five whole years in a cramped, three-pyeong goshiwon studio.[^2] Rats could be dealt with, and ghosts… Well, it wasn’t as if real ghosts would actually show up.
hunks.sol: I had survived five whole years in a cramped, three-pyeong goshiwon studio.[^2] Rats could be caught, and as for ghosts… Well, it wasn’t as though real ghosts would actually show up.

hunks.baseline: “As long as it’s spacious, I don’t mind.”
hunks.sol: “As long as it’s spacious, I’m fine.”

hunks.baseline: “So, no matter what the circumstances are, you don’t care as long as it’s spacious?”
hunks.sol: “So you don’t care about anything else, as long as it’s spacious?”

hunks.baseline: The premise sounded slightly ominous, but I nodded anyway. Jin Wikyung’s face brightened.
hunks.sol: That phrasing sounded slightly ominous, but I nodded anyway. Jin Wikyung’s face brightened.

hunks.baseline: “That’s a relief. I was worried you might dislike it.”
hunks.sol: “That’s a relief. I was worried you might not like it.”

hunks.baseline: We stopped in front of a large three-story pavilion. Compared to the other buildings we had passed, it was much cleaner and had a distinctly elegant, old-fashioned charm.
hunks.sol: We stopped in front of a large three-story pavilion. Compared to the other buildings we had passed, it was much cleaner and possessed a distinctly elegant, old-fashioned charm.

hunks.baseline: There was no reason at all to dislike a place like this.
hunks.sol: There was absolutely no reason to dislike a place like this.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung smiled brightly, looking pleased by my reaction.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung smiled brightly, clearly pleased by my reaction.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It’s much cleaner than I expected. And it looks incredibly spacious.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It’s much cleaner than I expected, and it looks incredibly spacious.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh. Two training halls!”
hunks.sol: “Oh! Two training halls!”

hunks.baseline: “If we divide them up, there shouldn’t be any problem.”
hunks.sol: “If you divide them between you, there shouldn’t be any problem.”

hunks.baseline: “Whoa. If we divide them up, that’d be perfect… Huh?”
hunks.sol: “Whoa. If we divide them, that’d be perfect… Huh?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not supposed to use it alone?”
hunks.sol: “I’m not using this place alone?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung gave an awkward smile.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung smiled awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: “It’s spacious enough for two people to use it together, isn’t it? You might grow closer while you’re at it.”
hunks.sol: “It’s spacious enough for two people, isn’t it? You might even grow closer while you’re at it.”

hunks.baseline: “Who?”
hunks.sol: “Who is it?”

hunks.baseline: Unease began to creep up my spine.
hunks.sol: Unease began creeping up my spine.

hunks.baseline: And a bad premonition was never wrong.
hunks.sol: And bad premonitions were never wrong.

hunks.baseline: “So, I’d like you to live together until your residence is rebuilt.”
hunks.sol: “So, I’d like you two to live together until his residence is rebuilt.”

hunks.baseline: “Let’s do that.”
hunks.sol: “Very well.”

hunks.baseline: His unexpected response surprised both me and Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: His response surprised both Jin Wikyung and me.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. But please send one person tomorrow.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. But please send me one person tomorrow.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. I was worried about you shutting yourself away in the training hall all alone anyway, so this works out well. I’ll find you a capable servant who’s quick on the uptake. Or should I hire a cook while I’m at it?”
hunks.sol: “Of course. I was worried about you shutting yourself away in the training hall all alone anyway, so this works out well. I’ll find you a capable servant who’s quick on the uptake. Or should I bring in a cook while I’m at it?”

hunks.baseline: “A servant or a cook is unnecessary.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t need a servant or a cook.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung gazed at me with deep, intent eyes.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung gave me a long, meaningful look.

hunks.baseline: “Please call a physician.”
hunks.sol: “Call a physician.”

hunks.baseline: An empty street with no people around. An underground training hall where not even a scream could escape. The perfect conditions for committing a crime.
hunks.sol: Deserted streets. An underground training hall where no one would hear a scream. The perfect conditions for committing a crime.

hunks.baseline: *He’s really made up his mind to beat me senseless.*
hunks.sol: *He’s made up his mind to beat me senseless.*

hunks.baseline: As I shivered, Jin Wikyung stammered out:

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “M-Mukyung. No, that’s not it, right? It’s not what I’m thinking, right?”
hunks.sol: As a chill ran through me, Jin Wikyung stammered, “M-Mukyung. You don’t mean that, do you? It’s not what I’m thinking, right?”

hunks.baseline: “Then you’ll need to call an undertaker instead of a physician.”
hunks.sol: “Then you’ll need an undertaker instead of a physician.”

hunks.baseline: I threw myself toward the exit without delay.
hunks.sol: Without a moment’s hesitation, I hurled myself toward the exit.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung caught me by the nape and dragged me back. Jin Mukyung gave a short laugh as he watched.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung caught me by the nape and hauled me back. Jin Mukyung let out a short laugh as he watched.

hunks.baseline: This time, I fired back without holding anything in.
hunks.sol: This time, I shot back.

hunks.baseline: “If something’s faster than me, is it really a dog? It’s Red Hare, isn’t it?”[^3]
hunks.sol: “If it’s faster than me, is it really a dog? That’d be Red Hare.”[^3]

hunks.baseline: “Even after taking that beating, you still haven’t come to your senses.”
hunks.sol: “Even after that beating, you still haven’t come to your senses.”

hunks.baseline: The booming shout shook the underground training hall. Unlike before, Jin Wikyung’s face had hardened.
hunks.sol: The booming shout shook the underground training hall. Jin Wikyung’s face had hardened, utterly unlike before.

hunks.baseline: I had never seen him like this. They said it was frightening when a good person got angry, and looking at Jin Wikyung now, I understood exactly what they meant.
hunks.sol: I had never seen him like this. They said it was frightening when a kind person got angry, and Jin Wikyung now showed me exactly what that meant.

hunks.baseline: “Instead of getting along as brothers, you’re trying to start a fight in front of me?”
hunks.sol: “You’re brothers. Instead of getting along, you’re trying to start a fight right in front of me?”

hunks.baseline: Under his fierce glare, both Jin Mukyung and I fell silent.
hunks.sol: Under his fierce glare, Jin Mukyung and I both fell silent.

hunks.baseline: “It isn’t half a year or a year. It’s only fifteen days. I’m asking you to live together just until the pavilion is finished. Was that such a difficult request?”
hunks.sol: “It isn’t half a year or a year. It’s only fifteen days. I’m asking you to live together until the pavilion is rebuilt. Is that really such a difficult request?”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung flinched. As the one who had demolished the pavilion, he had every reason to feel guilty.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung flinched. As the one responsible for demolishing the pavilion, he couldn’t help feeling guilty.

hunks.baseline: “That was because that guy was being rude…”
hunks.sol: “That was because this brat was being rude…”

hunks.baseline: “And that gives you the right to demolish a pavilion and beat up your little brother? You call that an excuse?”
hunks.sol: “And that gave you the right to demolish a pavilion and beat your little brother? You call that an excuse?”

hunks.baseline: I wanted to whip out my ID card, but I held myself back.
hunks.sol: I wanted to whip out my ID card, but I restrained myself.

hunks.baseline: This body was only twenty, and Jin Mukyung was my blood brother, three years older than me.
hunks.sol: This body was only twenty now, and Jin Mukyung was my blood brother, three years older than me.

hunks.baseline: “Answer!”
hunks.sol: “Answer me!”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung glared at us with a stern expression.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung glared sternly at both of us.

hunks.baseline: “This was a decision I reached after careful consideration. If you dislike each other that much, say so now. I’ll respect your wishes.”
hunks.sol: “This is a decision I reached after careful consideration. If you dislike each other that much, say so now. I’ll respect your wishes.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Mukyung and I locked eyes in midair.
hunks.sol: Jin Mukyung and I locked eyes.

hunks.baseline: Our answers came out at the same time.
hunks.sol: Our answers came at the same time.

hunks.baseline: “But I don’t want to.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t want to.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t want to either.”
hunks.sol: “Nor do I.”

hunks.baseline: *Was that even a question? He’d already decided on the answer.*
hunks.sol: *Why ask when he’d already decided on the answer?*
